title: Pinned Python installer with a host conflict preflight
goal: _tools/install-python.ps1 is committed: it installs the python.org CPython pinned in it (the minor version of .python-version) per user after checking its SHA-256 and signature, stops with exit 3 and changes nothing when its preflight finds a conflict on the host, and prints each conflict as a CONFLICT: line; a test plants conflicts and checks the stop; kb-setup and maintaining.md say how to run it and that every CONFLICT line goes to the user.
notes: The script, the kb-setup paragraph and the maintaining.md lines are committed; the test and the tools.md entry are not yet (TK-5s6ehtxp). On a Windows host: a pinned-version host reports already installed and changes nothing; a planted PYTHONHOME stops it with exit 3. Untested there: the machine-PATH and in-place-upgrade conflicts, which a test can plant only in a scratch registry hive or PATH.
